scope: Targeted Slice 2 catalog-row/Connect AI bug fix only; no Slice 3 or architecture change.

root_cause.component: Renderer model selection -> Preload setupCommandSchema/modelRefSchema validation
root_cause.description: Catalog-row onClick passed the entire CatalogModel object to choose(ref). TypeScript structural typing did not remove metadata at runtime. The strict model-reference schema accepts only providerId/modelId, so Preload rejected extra catalog fields before ipcRenderer.invoke. Renderer swallowed that rejection into the reported generic error.
root_cause.prior_test_gap: Earlier smoke tests selected models with an already minimal bridge payload; they did not click a real catalog row.
